The '''Sran system''' was a part of the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it contained the facility known as the [[Sran Outpost]]. At some point prior to the evacuation of the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] [[Dantooine base/Legends|base]] on<ref name="AIR" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="AIR" /> during that conflict,<ref name="TEA" /> the Sran Outpost came under attack, and the Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Risiev Credal]] participated in its defense.<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sran system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square T-6.<ref name="TEA" />
